title: ProServices / Solutions Weekly Sync - Customer Integration Standup (2026-02-20)
content:
Meeting: ProServices + Solutions weekly customer integration sync
Date: 2026-02-20 (Standup slot 10:00-10:30 PT)
Facilitator: Lena Moreno
Attendees: Lena, Marco, Aisha, Devon, Priya, Omar (notes)

Objective: Quick per-customer rollout status, surface blockers, align owners for next-week actions. Keep short — escalate anything >48h blocker.

1) Quick wins / announcements
- Shipping: new onboarding packet (v1) published to Confluence; includes template runbook and basic SLI checklist. (confluence:Customer-Handoff-Checklist-2026)
- Infra: Dedicated capacity for East-US staging requested and approved for Nimbus Health (SE-1421) — provisioning ETA 2/23.
- Infra note: GPU queue observed tail-latency spike Tue eve; infra team monitoring (incident followup scheduled).

2) Customer status snapshots (high-level)
- Nimbus Health (Handoff window: 2/24-2/28)
  - Current: Final integration tests on staging in progress. Prefix-caching behavior inconsistent at long-L2 prompts (seen on 8k token tests).
  - Owner: Marco Ruiz (SE) + Infra (Priya) for capacity.
  - Blockers: KV-cache mismatch causing duplicated tokens in resend path — suspected due to quantized model variant; ticket SE-1421 created. Impact: delays end-to-end validation, test failures 3/12 cases.
  - Next steps: Marco to attach failing prompt set and logs to SE-1421 by EOD 2/20. Priya to confirm staging GPU kernel selection and whether fallback to fp16 variant eliminates duplication (action: test by 2/21).
  - Customer comms: Set expectation email drafted (Devon) for 2/21 morning.

- EduPilot (Alpha pilot ongoing)
  - Current: EduPilot completed initial latency SLAs but reported occasional 500s from router when concurrent embedding workload spikes.
  - Owner: Aisha Patel (Solutions) + Omar (ProServ).
  - Blockers: Rate-limiter configuration on their integration route is too conservative; autoscale policy not triggering due to mis-tagged traffic. Jira PS-987 tracks the autoscale tag issue.
  - Next steps: Aisha to deploy temporary bump to route quota and observe for 24h (2/21-2/22). Omar to coordinate a short window with customer to reproduce at 3pm PT 2/21.

- MarketLens (Enterprise pilot, security review)
  - Current: Private deployment pre-checks completed; customer requested HSM integration and extended audit retention.
  - Owner: Priya Nair (Infra) + Devon (Solutions).
  - Blockers: KMS integration docs missing a step for key rotation policy; security team flagged for review.
  - Next steps: Priya to add missing KMS rotation example to docs and loop security (2/23). DevOps to sketch the rotation test plan (Devon, due 2/25).

3) Risks and cross-customer items
- Kernel selection flakiness: two customers hit token duplication when using quantized weights. Research/Applied ML needs to reproduce and recommend temporary mitigations (e.g., force fp16 path) — action: Aisha to open an alignment meeting with Applied ML on 2/22.
- Capacity planning: Dedicated pools provisioning time is stretching to 3-5 business days for some regions. For tight cutovers, we must offer burst options documented in the onboarding packet.
- Support SLA: Reminder to include on-call rotation notes in customer handoff doc (Lena to update template).

4) Action items (owners & due dates)
- Marco: Attach failing prompt set + logs to SE-1421 (due 2026-02-20 EOD).
- Priya: Run kernel fallback test for Nimbus staging (fp16 vs quantized) and report results (due 2026-02-21).
- Devon: Send customer-facing status update for Nimbus (draft by 2026-02-21 09:00 PT).
- Aisha: Bump EduPilot route quota for 24h and monitor; coordinate repro window with Omar (start 2026-02-21).
- Omar: Lead repro session with EduPilot at 2026-02-21 15:00 PT and capture router/embeddings metrics.
- Priya + Devon: Draft KMS rotation example and test plan for MarketLens (Priya draft 2/23; Devon test plan 2/25).
- Lena: Update handoff template with on-call and burst options (2/24).

5) Decisions made
- If kernel fallback resolves duplication for Nimbus tests, proceed with temporary fp16 pin for staging and plan a follow-up to fix quantized path in parallel (owner: Applied ML + Marco).
- For EduPilot, we will use temporary quota increase before changing autoscale tags; permanent fix tracked in PS-987.

6) Parking lot / unresolved questions
- Do we need a formal runbook entry for quantized-fallback steps? (Yes — add to onboarding packet if recurring.)
- Should we offer a paid burst add-on for customers who need same-day capacity? Product Ops to evaluate pricing (Lena to coordinate).

7) Metrics / quick numbers to track (for next sync)
- Onboarding lead time (contract signed -> staging green): target < 14 days (current gauge: 18 days).
- Mean time to remediate customer blocker (target < 48h): current rolling avg ~62h.
- Percentage of pilots using private deployment w/ KMS: 22%

8) Next meeting
- Weekly cadence: Fridays 10:00 PT. Next: 2026-02-27. If any blocker pops >48h, convene ad-hoc.

Notes / raw links:
- SE-1421 (duplication logs) -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-1421
- PS-987 (EduPilot autoscale tag) -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PS-987
- Confluence handoff packet -> confluence:Customer-Handoff-Checklist-2026

Quick informal notes to self (Lena):
- Push handoff template update after Priya posts KMS snippet.
- Check with Product Ops re: burst pricing models before EOM planning.
